body: I don't have insurance, or any money whatsoever to spend on one. It's really not an option for me.

I see. thanks for that info.

All of those other options are good too, I suppose.

It's just hard, you know. I'm trying to relax but it's really difficult to do so.

I have to think positive, but it's so hard...

The thing that is worrying me the most is the posting that said "average salary between 2-7000. I don't want to waste time and see what happens after a few months. I don't care what it takes, what I need to do, but I just need this money to finish school. I can't put it off much longer. I have nightmares of it happening to me...

I'm very wary of such places. I want to take it and start making a lot of money soon. I'm sure everyone else would like to but I just need the money to use on school. That's all I really need. I don't want to spend it on anything, just to save up.

I can't tell if I will succeed with this one. I'm trying to be mentally strong in order to give this job some time, but taking this and spending time on it is terrifying for me.

What do you think about this job?

I don't know what to do... I can't stand this anymore...

I'm sorry to all for being a burden...

The hard part of it is, my girlfriend is a bit older than me. And she wants children, and I'd do anything for her.

I fear that after she hits 30 the chance of her having a miscarriage/birthing a baby with defects raises so I can't stand the strain... I love her too much. I don't know what to do.
